verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs explicitly list per-certification compliance pages including SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS, plus other industry standards (ISO, FedRAMP, SOC 1), directly matching the platform-engineer's need to point security reviewers to documented attestations. Missing for 10: explicit HIPAA-specific attestation page (only inferred via general regulatory-compliance framing) and no independent/third-party audit evidence confirming these certifications beyond vendor docs.
